issue.body:
## 任务

自写 core.yaml、orderer.yaml，配置 MSP、TLS、gossip、CouchDB、Gateway、账本、指标和 participation API。

## 验收

- [ ] 节点健康与通道/链码 readiness 分开；启动依赖不冒充网络已可写。
- [ ] 在 M2 节点配置就绪并按原生步骤启动后，运行并记录完整 T-NET-02：同时核对渲染后的 Compose、仓库/构建上下文和真实 Peer、Orderer、CouchDB（以及现存 CA）容器的 `docker inspect`；证明无 docker.sock、无跨组织私钥挂载、Peer/CA/DB 管理端口不暴露公网、每 Peer 有独立状态卷。保留脱敏的命令、实际挂载/端口/卷结果和判定；节点未运行前只能标记 NOT RUN。
- [ ] 保存 §19.1 要求的脱敏证据；未执行项目标记 NOT RUN。

- [ ] 三份 orderer.yaml 的 Admin.TLS.Enabled=true、ClientAuthRequired=true，ClientRootCAs 只包含已测量的 orderer-admin-tls-ca 根；管理端服务证书/私钥由普通 orderer-tls-ca 签发且匹配。
- [ ] Peer/Orderer TLS 端点的信任根与访问 DNS/SAN 一致；三 Orderer 的 Raft 双向 TLS 客户端/服务端证书与通道配置中的 consenter 证书字节一致。不得以关闭验证修复证书错误。

## 追踪

- 规格：[SPEC.md](https://github.com/yjydist/supplyledger-lab/blob/main/SPEC.md) §§5.2–5.3、16.1
- 阶段：M2
- 关联：#12 的 M1 静态信任矩阵；#15 的 M2 静态拓扑和转入本 issue 的真实 `docker inspect`/T-NET-02；本 issue 实施 Peer、Orderer 和 Raft 的节点配置。

comment.body:
The reviewed Orderer join request-size fix is on main at [`be13906`](https://github.com/yjydist/supplyledger-lab/commit/be1390687f3dbc02f3f0c9e7407aa4ea4668a1a7). The first native Orderer0 join under the prior config was a real **FAIL**: `osnadmin` exited 0 but the admin API returned HTTP 400 while parsing the multipart body. Its post-request channel list remained null; the effective `ChannelParticipation.MaxRequestBodySize` was 0 on all three Orderers.

All three authored Orderer YAMLs now explicitly set `MaxRequestBodySize: 1 MB` (Fabric 3.1.5's sample value), and the source/rendered preflight enforces it. Fresh static checks passed: `make test-m2-nodes` (12 controls, including omitted/zero limits), `make network-config`, `make verify-m1`, native #17 block-to-node verification in an independent temporary render, Python syntax and diff checks. The temporary render changed exactly one limit line per Orderer and no Peer config. The runbook preserves original block, M1 identities, six credential env files and named ledger volumes through a checked one-time migration.

That migration, Orderer recreation/effective `1048576` observation, and join retry are **NOT RUN**. Full channel joins/**T-NET-04** and full live **T-NET-02** also remain **NOT RUN**; #16 stays open.

issue.body:
## 任务

逐个用 osnadmin 以专用 mTLS 身份加入应用通道，随后逐组织 Peer join、设置锚节点并记录命令。

## 验收

- [ ] 三 Orderer active；无证书的 admin 请求失败；三组织同高度块哈希一致，保留原网络数据。
- [ ] 运行并记录验收测试：T-NET-04。预期结果以 [SPEC.md](https://github.com/yjydist/supplyledger-lab/blob/main/SPEC.md) §20 为准。
- [ ] 保存 §19.1 要求的脱敏证据；未执行项目标记 NOT RUN。

- [ ] 三台 Orderer 管理端点分别使用专用 CA 签发的 osnadmin 客户端证书成功访问；无证书、由普通 Orderer TLS CA 或其他组织 TLS CA 签发且带 clientAuth 用途的有效客户端证书均在 TLS 客户端认证阶段失败。保留逐台命令、证书/根指纹、退出码和失败阶段，不使用跳过 TLS 验证。

## 追踪

- 规格：[SPEC.md](https://github.com/yjydist/supplyledger-lab/blob/main/SPEC.md) §§5.4、19
- 阶段：M2
- 关联：#12 的管理客户端凭证边界；本 issue 验证真实管理 API 的专用 CA 信任。

comment.body:
The first #18 native checkpoint is recorded at [`f87ed3a`](https://github.com/yjydist/supplyledger-lab/commit/f87ed3aab3ec99062a342145381ed584eef47525) in `evidence/m2/issue-18.md`.

All 12 individual admin TLS checks ran on the three channel-less Orderers: each dedicated client obtained HTTP 200 with `systemChannel:null` and `channels:null`; each no-cert request failed at TLS with `certificate required`; each valid ordinary Orderer TLS client and Seller Peer TLS client failed at TLS with `unknown ca`. The nine curl negatives verified the admin server root and exact DNS first.

The first native Orderer0 join used the original 27,946-byte #17 block and the dedicated client. `osnadmin` exited 0 but returned **HTTP 400** (`multipart: NextPart: http: request body too large`), so the join **FAILED** at request parsing. The three effective Orderer configs have `ChannelParticipation.MaxRequestBodySize=0`; #16's reviewed explicit size-limit fix is pending. An immediate post-failure native channel list remained HTTP 200 with both channel fields null, confirming no channel was created by that request.

Orderer1/2 joins, active status, Peer/CouchDB startup and full **T-NET-04** remain **NOT RUN**. The candidate block file checksum is not a live `genesisHash`. #18 remains open.
